name: Summoning the Princess
summary: At the Shards of Myzrael, you summon Myzrael and face her before she grows strong enough to challenge her captors. Theldurin the Lost wants her defeated and her Eldritch Shackles bound to the Shards.

sections.title: Why She Must Be Stopped
sections.body: Theldurin fears Myzrael will grow strong enough to turn against her captors. Some say she can be controlled. But Theldurin asks why the giants would have chained her if that were true.

sections.title: At the Shards
sections.body: You take the Scroll of Myzrael to the Shards, where you first spoke with her, and call her forth. Once Myzrael is defeated, you bind her Eldritch Shackles to the Shards and trap her again.

sections.title: When the Shackles Are Placed
sections.body: As Myzrael's shackles settle around the Shards, a wail rises from far below, then a roar. The Shards no longer offer warmth or safety. They pulse with menace, as though the thing beneath them bears ill will toward the surface.

faq.q: Who sends you to fight Myzrael?
faq.answer: Theldurin the Lost sends you to defeat Myzrael before her strength grows enough to challenge her captors.

faq.q: Where does the summoning take place?
faq.answer: You summon Myzrael at the Shards of Myzrael, where you first spoke with her.

faq.q: Why does Theldurin want Myzrael defeated?
faq.answer: Theldurin fears Myzrael will grow strong enough to challenge her captors. He asks why the giants chained her if she could truly be controlled.
You summon Myzrael at the Shards of Myzrael with the Scroll of Myzrael.

faq.q: What do you do with the Eldritch Shackles?
faq.answer: After defeating Myzrael, you bind her Eldritch Shackles to the Shards and trap her again.
